title: Special Topics in Contemporary Chinese Fiction and Film; Modern Chinese Literacy Criticism and Theory
description: One of the key forces behind China's cultural and intellectual modernization is the founding of a new literary tradition. This course studies how modern Chinese literary critics read, understand, and analyze modern Chinese literature by integrating modern ideas and practices with pre-modern ones and connecting Chinese and Western analytical traditions. Taught in English. No Chinese is required, though Chinese readings can be provided upon request. No course prerequisite.
